title: NPC与船员系统导致性能问题
description: 船员或NPC的寻路、数量过多等导致游戏卡顿、帧率下降或性能下降。
evidence: I've heard they can lead to performance and other issues
Crew pathfinding is poorly optimized and causes lots of lag (if you have more than one crew member it will slow your game to a crawl on higher FFW speeds)
NPCs causing lag and requiring debug tools to clean up every so-often

evidence_items.quote: After the last patch, the OKLG docking area has about 3× as many NPCs, and the game slows down badly.
evidence_items.description: 更新后OKLG停靠区NPC增多导致游戏严重变慢
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在上一个补丁之后，OKLG对接区大约有3倍的NPC，游戏严重变慢。

evidence_items.quote: I've heard they can lead to performance and other issues
evidence_items.description: 带船员会导致性能和其他问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我听说它们可能导致性能和其他问题

evidence_items.quote: Crew pathfinding is poorly optimized and causes lots of lag (if you have more than one crew member it will slow your game to a crawl on higher FFW speeds)
evidence_items.description: 船员寻路优化差，多名船员时在高倍速下游戏卡成幻灯片。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 船员寻路优化很差，会导致大量卡顿（如果你有不止一名船员，在较高的FFW速度下游戏会慢得像爬一样）

evidence_items.quote: station full of NPCs that kill the framerate
evidence_items.description: 空间站充满NPC导致帧率下降
evidence_items.quote_zh: 空间站里满是让帧率暴跌的NPC

evidence_items.quote: NPCs causing lag and requiring debug tools to clean up every so-often
evidence_items.description: NPC导致游戏卡顿，需要调试工具定期清理
evidence_items.quote_zh: NPC导致卡顿，并且需要时不时用调试工具来清理
